summary: Client config reads tolerate unknown top-level and nested keys with one naming warning; st doctor lists them and daemon loading remains strict.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or config version field changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Clients ignore unknown config keys while preserving validation of known values. Daemons and configuration mutation paths retain strict parsing. Already-deployed older clients still reject newly introduced keys.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or lifecycle change is introduced.

manual.detail: Restart sessions after installing an upgrade that adds configuration keys, so old clients on their PATH are replaced. Use st doctor to list unknown keys.

recovery.detail: No stored data changes. An older client can still reject keys written by a newer build; restart sessions using the upgraded client.
